framework_summary: A clinical-risk governance framework that maps clinical-decision-support deployments to MHRA Software as a Medical Device classification, NHS Digital DCB0129/0160 safety case assurance, and ISO 14971 risk management. The framework defines per-deployment risk artefacts (clinical safety case, hazard log, post-market surveillance plan) and the acceptance criteria a Trust safety officer signs off before clinical go-live.
framework_ownable_ip_summary: The ownable IP is (a) the proprietary deployment-tier rubric that classifies a clinical-decision-support workflow against MHRA + NHS Digital tiers in one rubric, (b) the canonical hazard-log template Meridian has used with 11 NHS Trusts since 2019, (c) the Trust-safety-officer acceptance-criteria checklist (refined through 38 deployments), and (d) the per-tier evidence-pack contract. The underlying regulatory text (MHRA SaMD, DCB0129/0160, ISO 14971) is public; the rubric, templates, checklists, and evidence-pack contract are Meridian's.
